servinfo.title: Generator Test
servinfo.ptxt: This condition, as evidenced by slow cranking or low specific gravity, can be caused by one or more of the following conditions even though warning light operates normally.

item.ptxt: Check that undercharged condition has not been caused by accessories being left on for an extended period.
Check accessory drive belt for wear and tension.
If battery defect is suspected, refer to Battery Description:K14D .
Check wiring for defects. Check all connections for tightness and cleanliness, battery cable connections at battery, starting motor and ignition ground cable.

s1.ptxt: Check that charge warning light (1) comes ON. If charge warning light never lights up, go to “Charge warning light does not light with ignition “ON” and engine off” under Generator Symptom Diagnosis:K14D .
If charge warning light remains ON, go to “Charge warning light does not go out with engine running (battery requires frequent recharging)” under Generator Symptom Diagnosis:K14D .
